thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - inference.redwood-api-prod p99 latency > 3s for 3m. Trigger: latency_p99 > 3000ms

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-48219 created and routed to escalation policy 'prod-latency'. Primary: Alex (oncall).

alex: Acked. I'm looking. grabbing traces and checking recent deploys.

alex: quick snapshot: p95 ~ 700ms, p99 ~ 3200-3800ms across region eu-west-1. error rate normal, timeouts increasing on long-context requests.

sasha: @alex any customer reports yet?

alex: Not from sysalerts. Logs show spike in token render time on model: llama-v2-q8_13b-serve. Queries with >2048 context are hitting slow path.

alex: running: ```kubectl logs -n inference svc/serve-llama-v2-13b -c model --tail=200 | grep "token_ms" | tail -n 20```

ops-bot: note: autoscaler did not add nodes in last 10m due to capacity threshold. (cpu/util 70%)

jamal: I'm on infra standby, switching to the incident channel. Can we route traffic to a lighter model while we investigate?

alex: good idea. Plan: 1) enable fallback to llama-v2-q4_13b for requests over 1s predicted latency, 2) throttle large-context requests, 3) investigate kernel/compilation slowdown.

sasha: customer impact: AcmePay is showing elevated checkout latency and a few 504s from their webhook integrations. I flagged SEV ticket with accounts.

infra-oncall: I'll take routing changes. Suggest we do a canary 5% shift first. Command to run: ```rwctl route update inference --add-fallback=llama-v2-q4_13b --canary=5% --reason="p99 burn"```

alex: executing canary now.```$ rwctl route update inference --add-fallback=llama-v2-q4_13b --canary=5%```

incident-bot: Action logged by alex: route update (canary=5%).

(2m pass)

alex: telemetry after 2m: p99 down from 3.4s -> 2.6s, p95 unchanged. some routing hits on fallback.

sasha: Any signs of GC or kernel stalls?

alex: grep from model node shows a pattern of long kernel compile time on first cold requests after a GC: ```[2026-11-04T20:10:12Z] kernel_compile_time_ms=1120, token_ms=4.5``` Might be a bad kernel selection after recent rollout.

jamal: Which commit rolled last night?

alex: rollout-id 2026-11-04-serve-kk-3f9a. It updated kernel selector heuristic. Rolling back to previous selector across 10% nodes now. ```deployctl rollback kernel-selector --to=2026-11-03-serve-kk-8d2b --percentage=10```

infra-oncall: Rolling back. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler too — maybe need to bump max nodes short term.

(another 3m)

alex: metrics: p99 now ~1.9s, p95 650ms. AcmePay reports checkout latency improving. No increase in error rate.

pagerduty: INC-48219 acknowledged by Alex, assigned to Jamal, escalated to infra-oncall.

sasha: Good. Are we comfortable moving from canary 5% -> 50%?

jamal: yes after we confirm no regressions. I'll push canary to 30% first: ```rwctl route update inference --canary=30%```

alex: done. also added a temporary latency filter to reject requests with context > 8k tokens with a 429 and a helpful retry header. ```nginx: if ($context_len > 8192) { return 429; add_header Retry-After 30; }```

ops-bot: note: Throttle rule applied by alex.

(5m)

alex: p99 stabilized ~1.2-1.5s across regions. No further 504s from AcmePay. Incident impact reduced to degraded performance for heavy-context workloads.

sasha: Are we keeping a postmortem? Also need alert tuning — PD fired at 3m burn threshold; maybe add transient suppress for known compile storms.

jamal: Agree. I'll own postmortem. Will create follow-up issues: 1) revert kernel-selector change fully after validation, 2) add proactive model warmup on scale-up, 3) tune p99 alert to require sustained increase and higher sample size.

alex: handing off to Jamal for extended mitigations. I'm going offline for the next 30m.

jamal: Taking over. I'll coordinate with support on customer comms. Thanks @alex.

incident-bot: INC-48219 status: mitigated -> monitoring. PagerDuty: incident will auto-resolve when metrics return to baseline for 10m.

sasha: quick note for follow-up: check rollout window process — we should gate kernel-selector changes behind a perf smoke test. :memo:

jamal: logged follow-ups and set initial P1 postmortem draft. Will ping oncall rotation for a blameless review tomorrow.

alex: :thumbsup: thanks team.

(reacts) :thumbsup: from sasha, :eyes: from infra-oncall, :white_check_mark: from pagerduty

---

Summary (short): p99 latency spike caused by recent kernel-selector rollout causing long compile stalls on cold paths for large-context requests. Immediate mitigations: routed traffic to q4 fallback (canary -> 30%), rolled back kernel-selector on portion of fleet, applied throttle for very large contexts. Customer AcmePay experienced degraded checkout latency and transient 504s; issue resolved after mitigations. Next actions: full rollback validation, warmup on scale, adjust PD alert sensitivity, create perf smoke tests for kernel selector changes.
